notes.title: New UPDATE available (Windows/MacOS/Linux)
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

We have just posted a new update for the game.

Changes include:

- fixed a bug where the character is not aligned with the grid, after a number of plays
- added 10 new achievements

notes.title: New UPDATE available (Windows/MacOS/Linux)
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

We have just posted a new update for the game.
Changes include:

- controls improvement: no more getting stuck by placing the bomb behind you
- added tutorial for changing regions 
- improved enemy animations
- improved character "idle" animations
- prices were adjusted 
- fixed some missions bugs:
        - corrected the score requirement for certain missions
        - corrected description for missions that require trees to be destroyed
- Christmas trees added for the winter region
- explosion particles were improved
- added a new bomb skin

tags.bug: - corrected the score requirement for certain missions
- corrected description for missions that require trees to be destroyed

tags.feature: - Christmas trees added for the winter region
